name: Jt Parr
office: City of Burbank, Member of the City Council

items.text: JT Parr is a professional comedian who runs a media company. In a 2024 candidate statement, he said he had attended Burbank council meetings for a decade. He taught English abroad and holds a screenwriting degree from Loyola Marymount University.

sentences.text: JT Parr is a professional comedian who runs a media company.
In a 2024 candidate statement, he said he had attended Burbank council meetings for a decade.
He taught English abroad and holds a screenwriting degree from Loyola Marymount University.

items.text: His campaign statement says he wants to build more housing, expand public transportation, and create free public gathering spaces. At a League of Women Voters forum, he said he initially favored restrictive rent control but now sees it as a supply issue and calls for cutting red tape and upzoning. He opposes Measure CD, the proposal to switch to by-district council elections, saying it would shrink the talent pool and create turf wars.
